Subject: Vendor invoice submission: portal vs email and field mapping questions

Hi Aditya / Lauren,

Thanks for onboarding Novus Supply as an approved vendor. A couple of quick questions on how you prefer to receive invoices so we can align our ERP export: 

1) Portal vs email: do you require all invoices to be uploaded to Redwood's vendor portal, or is AP email acceptable for low-volume vendors?
2) PO stamping: should we place the Redwood PO number in the invoice header or as a line-level field? Our system currently exports it as a second line item. Will that cause issues with your matching?
3) EU invoices: where would you like our VAT / Tax ID recorded (header vs each line)?
4) File naming: do you have a recommended filename convention?

I've attached a sample invoice and our standard CSV export from our ERP for your reference. If there's a template you prefer, happy to reformat.

Attachments: sample_invoice_novus_0324.pdf (pdf), novus_export_20270324.csv (csv)

Looking to avoid payment delays — please let us know the preferred path so we can adjust ASAP.

Best,

Novus Supply

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood-inference.com>

Subject: Re: Vendor invoice submission: portal vs email and field mapping questions

Hi Elena — great to meet you and thanks for the sample files. Short answers up front: portal preferred, email acceptable as fallback, and SFTP is an approved high-volume option. Details below to avoid any matching/payment delays.

Preferred channel
- Vendor portal: preferred for all recurring vendors. Uploads create automated receipts and speed approvals (recommended).
- Email: invoices@redwood-inference.com is the fallback if your portal export fails or for one-off/consulting invoices. Use that address and include a PO number in the subject line.
- SFTP: acceptable for scheduled batch deliveries (see SFTP notes below).

Required invoice fields (portal form or CSV columns)
- Invoice number (unique)
- Invoice date (ISO YYYY-MM-DD)
- Total amount (currency code required, e.g., USD)
- Redwood PO number(s) — see PO guidance below
- Line-level description, qty, unit price, line total (if you send line items)
- Tax ID / VAT (see regional notes)
- Bill-to legal entity code (if you serve multiple Redwood entities)

PO stamping and multiple POs
- Preferred: place the Redwood PO in the header field labeled "PO Reference" when uploading to the portal. If you must include multiple POs on a single invoice, include a separate line for each PO with a matching "PO Reference" column. Our AP system reconciles by the PO Reference column when present.
- If your ERP exports the PO on line 2 (as you noted), that's OK so long as the CSV column is named PO_Reference or the portal mapping is set to pick that column.

EU / VAT guidance
- Include VAT/Tax ID in the invoice header (Tax ID field) and also as a VAT column at line level if you invoice split-tax items. That ensures our tax team and compliance cadence can process automatically.

File naming and attachments
- Recommended filename: Redwood-PO_<PO#>_Novus-<invoice-number>.pdf (e.g., Redwood-PO_12345_Novus-INV1902.pdf) when emailing.
- Portal uploads: attachments are treated as supporting docs. Please include one PDF copy of the invoice; invoices with multiple supporting docs (delivery receipt, certificate of origin) are fine as separate attachments. Max combined size 15 MB per upload.

SFTP for batches
- SFTP is fine for scheduled high-volume flows. We'll provide host, username, and a directory pattern after we validate your certificate. For a trial, send a single CSV and a matching PDF per invoice.

Attached: vendor-onboarding-invoice-template.xlsx (a simple CSV/column mapping sample).

Next step: Can you send one converted invoice per the attached template (portal or CSV) so our AP team can verify mapping? If portal, send a screenshot of the mapping screen.

Thanks,

Aditya Rao

Hi Elena — looping in AP and our automation lead for a couple of the mapping items. Answers below: 

1) Delivery/service dates: Please include delivery_date as a separate column if you have it. Having the line-level delivery_date enables our receiving team to auto-match receipts. If you cannot provide line-level dates, the invoice_date header is acceptable but may trigger manual review for certain PO types.

2) VAT / Tax ID: Header Tax ID is required for EU invoices. For cross-border VAT (reverse charge scenarios) please also include a VAT column on the line items. Our tax team runs additional checks if VAT is only in the header, which can slow payment.

3) PO position: As Aditya mentioned, we key off the column header PO_Reference. If your CSV uses that header we will accept the PO in row 2; our portal mapping allows mapping by header name. If you upload PDFs to the portal, put the PO in the header section.

4) SFTP details: SFTP is approved for recurring batches >50 invoices/month. For next steps:
- Send your public key to sftp-keys@redwood-inference.com
- We will create a vendor folder: sftp.redwood-inference.com:/incoming/novus_supply/
- File naming convention for batches: novus_YYYYMMDD_batch.csv + accompanying PDFs named novus_INV<number>.pdf

5) Multiple Redwood legal entities: if a single invoice contains lines for different Redwood legal entities, include a column "BillToEntity" with one of the codes we shared previously (RWI-US, RWI-EU). Otherwise payments may be delayed while AP routes the invoice.

Attachments: sftp_instructions.txt (basic key exchange + folder layout), ap_contact_card.vcf (AP team card).

Payment SLA: standard Net 30 from invoice date once fully validated. If you upload to the portal and mappings match, typical processing is ~5–7 business days to payment.

Please send a 2–3 invoice test set (CSV + PDF) to the portal or drop via SFTP after you share the public key. We'll confirm mapping and unblock production.

Thanks,
